# ChivarGo

> ChivarGo (ชีวาร์โก) is a healthy, low-impact island travel app for Koh Samui (Surat Thani) and Koh Sichang (Chonburi), Thailand. It is free for travellers on the web at https://chivargo.com/ and speaks Thai, English and Simplified Chinese.

Core idea: a point is only worth something if somebody had to check it. Green Points are issued only when a named local host approves a geotagged submission made inside a geofence on a given date. Trip Points are self-verified and are always shown separately.

## Features
- Green Points (host-verified) and Trip Points (self-verified)
- Quests and missions: beach clean-ups, waste drop-off, coral, local treasure, secret recipe, Trash Hero
- Adventure Map across the island
- Chivar Bot: AI concierge that recommends places from in-app data and says so when it has none
- Maps, getting-there directions, on-foot navigation, offline use
- SOS button and an island condition card
- Party: find travel mates, shared proof for a team, coastal watch parties, event mode
- Companions, 77 province mascots, capsule draws, backpack
- Passport, medals, seasons and leaderboard
- Local Picks: local restaurants, shops, markets, food courts
- Stay inquiries with terms stated by the operator
- Community feed and moderated reviews
- Travel journal, mini games, points wallet
- Hotels: a verifiable activity statement to attach to the sustainability/ESG report they already file (it measures no building and replaces no number)
- Host console for operators to verify activity
